newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound o/n rates tend up, one-week steady.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound o/n rates tend up, one-week steady.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound tended upwards on Monday in a slightly short private sector market, to between 8-1/4 and nine percent from Sunday's range of between 7-3/4 and nine percent, bankers said.
One banker quoted overnight rates as high as 9-1/4 percent.
Many bankers said they did not make any one-week deals but some quoted rates as steady between 8-1/2 and nine percent.
The bankers said that public-sector banks kept their official minimum lending rate steady at 10-1/2 percent.
